title: Class Odyssey — integrated basic boy and girl characters
source: Nintendo / The Models Resource — Trikeboy; source lineage recorded in assets/wardrobe/provenance.json.
request: Première intégration des personnages garçon et fille basiques dans l’application, correction de la nuque, des coiffures et des bras le long du corps, en coordination avec items/update.
geometry: Evaluated base wardrobe geometry. Actual head/body neck boundary loops connected and welded, UV layers canonicalized before joining. Head and body scalp paint cleared. New separate short/bob hair meshes. No optional outfit, held item or backpack is included.
pose: Shared items/update contract: arms lowered 82 degrees from T-pose, elbows flexed 8 degrees, fingers flexed slightly, palms toward thighs. glTF Y-up, face +Z, metres, origin at ground.
variants: boy and girl, each in the five existing game skin tones: light, medium, tan, brown, dark.
portraits: Actual Blender Cycles renders of the corrected GLBs at 512x896, 32 samples, transparent film, soft daylight. WebP portraits and 256x448 thumbnails derived from the PNG renders.
neckChecks: Rear close-ups of each repaired character with hair hidden, rendered at 640x640. These validate the actual closed neck surface rather than hiding the opening behind hair.
textures: Source albedos adapted for the existing five skin-tone settings; connected painted scalp regions removed while retaining face detail.
anchors: manifest.json contains per-character local/world positions and xyzw quaternions, hat-seat ellipse and anatomical frame conventions.
credits: The underlying source morphology is a credited derivative, not a claim of wholly original anatomy. New neck continuity, hairstyles, pose, export contract and application integration belong to this Class Odyssey study.
